thread:
eli: FYI I opened a PR to update the model catalog entry for sylph2b. Main items: clarify supported sequence ranges, add a short migration note about variant pinning, include a tiny Python SDK snippet showing variant + fallback, and fix the bench anchor link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012
zoe: Thanks. Is the bench link new or just an anchor change?
eli: Anchor change. The bench page renamed the heading so the old /#bench-results anchor 404ed. I updated the model card to point at /bench#sylph2b.
sam: Good catch. Runtime also asked for a cold-start note for the int8 fallback, can we mention ~1.3x cold-start latency?
eli: Yep added a one-liner under compatibility: "int8 variants may have ~1.3x cold-start latency compared to fp32 due to quantized kernel initialization."
frank: Also request from infra: add a YAML flag so Console can surface fallback info. Something like `variants:\n  - name: sylph2b-fp32\n  - name: sylph2b-int8\n    fallback: true` in the model metadata.
zoe: Can you add that to the PR meta? UI teams will read it from the catalog YAML.
eli: Added it. Also updated the limits table to recommend a 60ms batch window for >6k tokens on GPUs to hit throughput targets. Runtime approves.
docs-ci-bot: check failed 12 docs/anchor-check: missing anchor `/bench#sylph2b` on target page.
sam: I'll push a tiny markdown change to the bench page to add the anchor header. Want to be careful with the TOC though.
eli: Thanks. Also included a Python SDK v4 snippet in the PR comments. Current snippet:
```py
# prefer fp32, allow int8 fallback
resp = client.generate(
  model="sylph2b",
  variant="sylph2b-fp32",
  fallback_variants=["sylph2b-int8"],
  input="Explain the new migration steps.",
  max_tokens=400
)
print(resp.output[0].content)
```
zoe: Could we also show how to pin the variant by model id in the CLI example? Useful for customers migrating.
eli: Added a short CLI snippet in the migration note: `--model sylph2b-fp32` and a note: "Pin the variant to avoid runtime fallback-induced latency variance."
sam: Pushed bench anchor fix.
docs-ci-bot: all checks green on PR 1012 (linkcheck, linter, spell).
frank: Quick ask: can we include a p50/p95 bench blurb in the card (one line) so sales can use it in decks?
eli: Done. Added p50=82ms, p95=210ms (internal bench link included).
zoe: Nice. I'll backport a small copy to the v2 docs site after merge.
eli: Filed an internal note for Support with fallback behavior and cold-start note: https://intranet.redwood.ai/notes/sylph2b-fallback
sam: LGTM, approving the PR now.
eli: Merging after CI passes. Thanks all. :tada:
zoe: :thumbsup:
frank: Great, thanks everyone.
eli: thread closed after merge.
